# Pick O Pick

> Pick O Pick helps customers worldwide shop from India, arrange doorstep pickup, consolidate purchases, and ship parcels internationally from India to overseas destinations.

Pickopick Private Limited is based in Guindy, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Customers can request sourcing support, send personal items, arrange food and grocery packing, consolidate purchases from multiple sellers, or request a verified shipping quotation.

## Core services

- [Shop from India](https://pickopick.com/shop): Search marketplace products and request India-side shopping support.
- [NRI shipping and concierge](https://pickopick.com/nri): Plan an India shipment, consult specialists, source, collect, consolidate and ship items abroad.
- [Shipping estimate request](https://pickopick.com/shipping-estimate): Submit package details for a verified quotation via WhatsApp or email. Prices are not published as a public calculator.
- [Prohibited and restricted items](https://pickopick.com/prohibited): Review item restrictions before shipping.
- [Contact Pick O Pick](https://pickopick.com/contact): Phone, email and Chennai office details.

## Useful details

- Primary service area: India pickup and sourcing with international delivery.
- Contact phone: +91 97903 61222.

- Consultation: Free NRI shipping consultation is available through the NRI page.
